resolutions.researcher_notes: The existing ref was mis-flagged dead -- youm7.com resolves live (200). Its body (fetched directly, since the exact pound-figure substring can't be screened through a generic verifier check) states verbatim: 'خط غاز التينة/أبو سلطان/العاصمة الإدارية (المرحلة الأولى والثانية) بطول 165 كم وقطر 42 بوصة ... وتبلغ التكلفة الاستثمارية للمشروع حوالى 3335 مليون جنيه، وتم تشغيله فى يوليو 2019' -- i.e. the El Tina/Abu Sultan/Administrative Capital gas line, phases I & II, investment cost ~3,335 million EGP, commissioned July 2019. That is an exact match to ProjectLevelCost=3,335,000,000 EGP. Only one source found for this specific figure -> medium, not independent. The seed-citation petroleum.gov.eg PDF ('مشروعات الشبكة القومية للغازات الطبيعية') was opened and read in full but covers a different, more recent tranche of lines (it names 'التينة غرب/ميت نما' -- El Tina West/Mit Nama -- not this Abu Sultan/Administrative Capital segment) so it does not corroborate this cost figure.
